text: The Ukraine aid bill hides an impeachment trap for a future Trump presidency
The bill does not mention impeachment and does not target Trump
The bill makes funds available but does not force any president to spend them
Vance's warning is speculation or opinion and cannot be checked
Disagreement with Vance belongs in the comments, not in notes
Trump was impeached for seeking a political favour, not for withholding money
Presidents must spend funds Congress appropriates; withholding them is illegal
Democrats and the establishment use the bill to prolong the war and attack Trump
Republicans should vote the bill down and stop funding Ukraine
Vance is honest for exposing this
